name: kit morning run
_about: Preconditions of the unattended morning run (scripts/morning.py step 0, fatal). Paths are relative to the kit root, which morning.py uses as the working directory. Library skill: claude-core-skills .claude/skills/independent-audit/. Owner 2026-10-21. Only what the WHOLE run needs belongs here: playwright was removed 2026-10-21 because the deck step already fails closed without it, and a fatal preflight on it would have stopped a morning whose other steps all passed (runner, 18:34Z).

checks.name: kit checkout
checks.hint: the run is not inside the fantasy-basketball-2026-27 checkout; clone it and run from its root

checks.name: deck repo beside the kit
checks.cmd: python3 -c "import os,sys; d=os.environ.get('DECK_REPO') or '../yahoo-fantasy-basketball'; sys.exit(0 if os.path.isfile(os.path.join(d,'scripts','hoops.py')) else 1)"
checks.hint: the season board and deck import hoops.py from the deck repo; attach nic095layson/yahoo-fantasy-basketball beside the kit or set DECK_REPO
